why_this_is_failed_not_partial: Unlike source 3's page-by-page JSON pulls, a git clone is all-or-nothing: refs, HEAD, and a checked-out working tree are only written once the full pack transfer completes. Interrupting it leaves .git/objects and .git/refs empty (confirmed below) - there is no usable partial state, no commit to point to, nothing that would pass git fsck. Correctly classified failed, not partial.
